slides.texte_overlay:
things to do on your own
that make you
mentally bulletproof

go to the movies alone

pick the film you want.
no one to agree with.

walk through a museum alone

stay as long as you like
in front of one piece.

ask a stranger for directions

yes, even with a phone.
the fear is smaller than you think.

join a class where
you know no one

be the beginner in the room.
it stops feeling strange fast.

spend a saturday offline

no feed. no updates.
you'll find out what you actually like.

learn something every day,
even when no one's watching

five quiet minutes.
that's how it starts.
